payload.title: Post editing and deletion rules (ADR 0010)
payload.context: The editor needs rules for when a post can change or be removed without weakening the approval rule or losing the record of something public. See docs/adr/0010-post-editing-and-deletion.md.
payload.rationale: Content changes only in draft; returning to draft removes the approval. Approval requires a fingerprint of what the user saw. Only drafts and rejected posts with no published or outcome-unknown variant can be deleted.
payload.consequences: Editing an approved post needs a new approval. Published posts stay as a local record; deleting from the platform is not offered in M3.
